description: Oscar Kraan published this conceptual agent-based model of an electricity market. Investors own generation assets, supply electricity and decide whether to build additional capacity. Electricity prices arise from supply and demand in an energy-only market. The model is intended to examine processes involved in electricity-system transitions using a limited set of agent types and behavioural rules. Coverage is a conceptual market; the source does not identify a calibrated national system, fixed geographic resolution or validated forecast period. It supports simulation of capacity investment and market dynamics. Results represent the chosen rules and assumptions, and this metadata review does not establish forecasting accuracy. Release 1.2.0 is available free through the CoMSES code repository and lists NetLogo. The release licence is GPL-3.0. Source code and model data were not downloaded or executed. Related resources include the CoMSES computational model library.
